notes.title: Bug Fixes and Perks!
notes.notes:
Perks

Added the framework for perks, as well as some perks to play around and test. This will be part of the progression system in the game, dying causes you to lose your perk, and you get 1 perk point per level. These vary from small help to make the game easier, to complete game changers giving you a massive upper hand, we look forward to seeing what you think of them and are open to more suggestions!

Fixes


 Fixed a bug where only Mercy Hill had ghostly voices
 Fixed a bug where the entity wasn't removed off your screen on Long Isle Factory
 Fixed most issues pertaining to AI:
  - No footsteps for some
  - Wouldn't scream when seeing the player
  - No sound when roaming around (random grunts, chatter, etc)
  - Wouldn't chase bottle after it was smashed
  - Wouldn't pick up the pace as it got angrier
  - Wouldn't cooldown after killing a player
  - Wouldn't go back to correct speed after cooldown period
  - Didn't have correct sound effects (wrong voice lines sometimes)
  - Wouldn't randomly scream
  - Wouldn't notify that they've gotten angrier
 Fixed a bug where all items had different locations for different players on Ridgeview and Long Isle
 Fixed a bug where there were multiple items for each player (4 players, 4 sets of necklaces) on Ridgeview and Long Isle
 Fixed a bug where all players got the jumpscare when another player died
 Fixed a bug where all players got the screenshake when another player died
 Fixed a bug where you could walk into lights in Ridgeview High
 Fixed the sunken toilets on Ridgeview
 Fixed a bug where some entities couldn't open doors
 Fixed objects floating off walls on Ridgeview
 Fixed a bug where you could get stuck behind the pipes on Long Isle Factory
 Fixed a bug where entities would sometimes get stuck on obscure objects when walking past them
 Fixed all instances of doors deforming and changing shape when opened or closed


Changes


 Made it so whenever you do an action that angers the entity, it comes to the location (turning on a generator causes the entity to come to that generator, etc)
 Adjusted flashlights so they're different for each map
 Given more visual feedback for placing objects on the summoning circle
 Added more logical background sounds for each map
 Different surfaces now have different footstep sounds

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixes


 Fixed a bug where you could pick up items through walls on Ridgeview High.
 Fixed a bug where you couldn't crouch.
 Mixed the sounds so they make more sense, footstep audio, entity audio, etc.
 Fixed a bug where it was hard to tell what direction sounds were coming from.
 Fixed a bug where sounds weren't occluded by walls.
 Fixed necklace size on Ridgeview High.
 Fixed a bug where the entity wouldn't get more aggressive in Ridgeview High.
 Fixed a bug where Steam wasn't working, and you were forced to host locally.


Changes

 Added different footstep sounds for each surface

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Changes and New Content
notes.notes:
Fixes:


 Fixed graphical issues on the tutorial map.
 Fixed a bug where everyone could see the death animation for any player.
 Fixed a bug where the entities would hit max running speed after killing a player.
 Fixed a bug where Long Isle Factory didn't have a kill animation when you were caught.


Changes

 Removed lockers <- These will be changed to something cleaner and more logical in the future.
 Removed Northwood. It didn't feel like it fit the rest of the vibe of the game we're going to be going with, and suffered massive performance issues. We're still aiming for 5 maps at launch, so this just means we get 2 unique maps on launch instead of 1.
 Dead players can now interact with doors, allowing them to help the entities find them, close doors on their friends, or just play with them to scare their friends
 Significantly reduced footstep volume for the entities, making it easier to locate where they are, as well as letting the new audio stand out more.
 Temporarily made the killing animation only has 1 sound effect, this will be changed once we get more.


Added


 Given the dead players the ability to throw bottles, this is currently on a 15-second cooldown, but we will adjust this in the future, you don't need to be holding a bottle to throw one, and players that are alive can see it. All entities will run to wherever they hear it smash.
 Added feedback when picking up cursed objects in Long Isle Factory ("Cursed object collected"), etc...
 Made it so the cursed objects whisper to you, this helps you figure out where they are a lot easier, the voices are also randomised so you won't hear two objects "saying" the same thing.
 Changed the entity for the Long Isle Factory, previously it was the same as Northwood, and even though Northwood has been removed we don't want to lazily use the same entity model, we feel the new model fits the lore that we're going for significantly better, and we'll repurpose the other model elsewhere in the future. (The new entity will also come with new animations in the near future).
 Added new "ambient" audios for the entities, now instead of running around screaming randomly every X seconds, they'll also be grunting, groaning, etc inbetween. This significantly adds to the immersion, each entity will make different sounds as they run around.

notes.title: More Small Bug Fixes and Changes
notes.notes:
Fixed:


 Fixed a bug where you would need to restart your game to enable/disable Headbob
 Fixed a bug where settings would enable/disable other settings randomly (changing FOV would reset sensitivity)
 Fixed a bug where none of the audio settings were linked correctly, meaning you couldn't adjust them individually
 Fixed a bug where players would continue to glide when attacked by the entities
 Fixed a bug where crouching after being pushed over would break the camera
 Fixed a bug where the trees outside Mercy Hill were waving up and down constantly
 Fixed random light in the church in Northwood


Changed:


 Significantly improved FPS in Mercy Hill
 Doubled the FPS in Northwood
 Made the camera movement for getting pushed over smoother, it no longer snaps to the floor and snaps up
 Populated the buildings inside Northwood

notes.title: Bug Fixes / Changes
notes.notes:
Fixed:


 Fixed a bug where the FOV would change if you changed the sensitivity
 Fixed a bug where the random scream time was set to 0, causing the entity to scream constantly
 Fixed a bug where the ragdoll was the default UE5 mannequin still, it now uses your customized character
 Fixed broken textures on Northwood
 Fixed the light bleeding through the walls from the fireplace in the lobby
 Fixed a bug where the game would crash if you tried to change certain settings
 Fixed a bug where you couldn't walk over the note
 Fixed a bug where the items on Northwood would sometimes trap you
 Fixed more settings that changed your FOV
 Cleaned up and fixed all the animations, previously they were linked to the wrong skeleton, all the animations have been redone for the new skeleton
 Fixed a bug where you would start 10 levels ahead
 Fixed a bug where you sometimes wouldn't get sent back to the lobby when you die or win
 removed "generator is on"
 Fixed a bug where you couldn't walk up some stairs in Northwood
 Fixed a bug where the Northwood entity scream was set to 2D audio instead of actually coming from her and her direction
 Fixed a bug where the Northwood entity would sometimes not spawn
 Fixed a bug where the hospital entity would sometimes not spawn
 Fixed a massive amount of AI pathing issues
 Fixed a bug where Maria had no first-person animations
 Fixed a bug where the kill animation would play for all players, even if they weren't attacked


Changed:


 After killing a player, the entity temporarily loses its anger status (becomes slowed down to a walking speed, will look for you less, worse sight/hearing)
 Significantly reduced the number of times the entity will scream
 Added a cleaner kill animation
 When being eaten by the entity, you can no longer just run around and look around, you're stuck in place being attacked
 Made it so that instead of it hanging after the animation, it instantly kills the player (uses the animation length for death instead of a random number) 
 Cleaned up a lot of the navigation issues, such as having the press escape to close some things, and the close button for others
 Significantly reduced the spawn rate of the apparitions
 Significantly improved lighting in the tutorial map, and provided a flashlight
 Changed up the jumpscare, now its got multiple sounds and shakes the screen
 Changed up wording for the generator notes, making it clearer what you have to do.
